title: Rotate Image
statement_short: Given an n x n 2D matrix representing an image, rotate the image by 90 degrees clockwise in-place.
hint: n up to 20 demands an in-place O(n^2) solution using matrix transpose and row-reversal pointers.
keywords: rotate the image by 90 degrees clockwise
why_not: Right: Two Pointers transposes the matrix and then reverses each row using opposite-end pointer swaps in O(n^2) time and O(1) space. Not Math / Geometry: Coordinate rotation formulas calculate new indices, but require an extra auxiliary matrix violating in-place constraints. Not 2D DP: State transition optimization does not apply to static 2D grid index permutations. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Mapping coordinates to values uses unnecessary O(n^2) auxiliary memory.
